mentions.name: nofone
mentions.description: This platform ingests health insurance policies and provides insights to insurers on how to improve them, and to doctors on what insurers expect to see in documentation and evidence. Its goal is to improve the claim denial situation and, down the line, standardize medical necessity criteria.
mentions.problem: Health insurance claim denials and inconsistent, opaque medical necessity criteria between insurers and doctors.
mentions.audience: Insurance companies and doctors navigating documentation and evidence expectations.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built https://nofone.io . I ingest health insurance policies and provide insights to insurers on how to improve them and doctors to know what insurers expect to see in documentation and evidence. My hope is to improve the denial situation and standardize medical necessity criteria down the line.
